text:
If that dense morning fog has you second-guessing the day, hang tight, it's burning off by mid to late morning and leaving a good deal of sunshine behind. A stray shower is possible right around 7 to 8, but the forecasters aren't worried about it, and the models mostly back that up, with only the American model hinting at any real wetness later. High near 80, light north wind, and air quality's clean, so it's a genuinely nice one once that fog clears. The lake's calm too, waves a foot or less and water sitting at a comfortable 73, wind under 10 knots all day.

Wednesday holds a better shot at real rain, showers and maybe a rumble of thunder moving in during the afternoon, so keep the umbrella handy but don't scrap outdoor plans for the morning. Tonight's a clear, easy one, low around 61.

Good call: get on the water or into the yard once the fog lifts late morning, and enjoy it through the afternoon, today's the pick of the two.
